constructor
· intro h
  intros s a hnotin
  have hsubset : s ⊆ insert a s := subset_insert a s
  have hneq : s ≠ insert a s := by rintro rfl; exact hnotin
  exact h s a hnotin
· intro h
  intros s t hsub hneq
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, a ∈ t \ s :=
    by rw [diff_eq_insert]; exact hneq
  have ht : t = insert a s :=
    by rw [diff_eq_insert]; exact ⟨ha, hsub⟩
  exact h s a (by contraposition ht)
